Campus Health Services offers free flu vaccinations and
recommends that everyone except those with vaccine allergies come
to get the quick and effective shot.

in reducing your exposure to the flu virus. And of course, if you
feel sick, avoid close contact with others to keep from spreading
Flu symptoms include fever, aches, sore throat, and fatigue.
While these symptoms are also typical of the common cold, the flu
tends to come on quite rapidly and symptoms can be severe.
